Elon Musk has become the world's first half-trillionaire, making him a prominent figure in financial news. Data demands from governments, such as those issued to UK Apple users, raise privacy concerns. In business, Tesco is voicing frustration over business taxes, and Thames Water lenders have submitted a rescue plan amid potential collapse. The world of technology also saw developments like Instagram's denial of using user microphones for listening, the rise of self-driving trucks startup Einride, and advancements in space transportation with the Arc spacecraft.
